feeds.title: Eating European
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Edyta. I'm a recipe developer, photographer, and writer behind the Eating European food blog of European and Mediterranean healthy and delicious recipes. I consider myself a home chef with a cultivated passion for amazing food.

feeds.title: Eating Europe Blog
feeds.description: We are giving people a taste of Europe they won't soon forget by exposing them to real food, people and neighbourhoods. Our mission is to leave travelers with an unparalleled, non-touristy, food-related experience in undiscovered neighborhoods of the most fascinating cities in the world.

feeds.title: AngiesWeb » European Cuisine
feeds.description: Born and growing up in Germany, I like to travel and explore the culture and cuisine of places in Europe. Once back home in my kitchen, I recreate the recipes from my travels. Besides globetrotting, my hobbies are baking (cooking), painting, and glass mosaic art.

feeds.title: MyGourmetConnection » European
feeds.description: Hi there! We're Lynne & Erika. Our collection of European recipes features food inspired by the fabulous and varied cuisines of France, Germany, Ireland, England, Poland, Hungary, Portugal, Spain, and more. MyGourmetConnection is a family-run food blog filled with recipes and inspiration for folks who enjoy cooking and serving great food.

feeds.title: The European Dish
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to my small European Kitchen. Here you can discover tasty, healthy and seasonal recipes that families can enjoy together every day. Be my guest and look around. I'm sure you'll find something good!

feeds.title: Where Is My Spoon » Eastern European Recipes
feeds.description: I was born in Romania, so Eastern European recipes are closest to my heart. In this category, you will find recipes from the rest of Eastern Europe. Where Is My Spoon is a blog where you will find delicious and family-friendly recipes, all made from scratch. From simple healthy soups to sumptuous cakes for special occasions, all our recipes have been tried and loved by our family and our friends.

feeds.title: Saveur » European
feeds.description: See the latest European stories from Saveur. See news, trends, tips, reviews, and more at Saveur. SAVEUR is the global guide to cooking, entertaining, and food travel. Bring home the world's best recipes, drinks, seasonal dishes, and tips.

feeds.title: Together Magazine » Food and drink
feeds.description: Get to know more about food and drinks to try in Brussels through Together Magazine. Together is THE high-class English language magazine for international business people in Brussels - a perfect blend of personal development, lifestyle, and leisure. Our aim is to inspire our readers to reach their dreams.

feeds.title: Tasting Table » European
feeds.description: Where to eat in Europe right now, plus recipes from across the continent. Tasting Table is a one-stop shop for all food and drink enthusiasts. We bring you practical cooking tips and dining advice, must-try recipes you can trust, and all the top news from the food world.

feeds.title: Travel Food Atlas » Europe
feeds.description: European food is some of the most delicious, unique, interesting, and tasty in the world, but there are also some very weird and unusual recipes to try from Europe too. Discover a world of amazing traditional European recipes and foods! For the past 10 years, Travel Food Atlas has pioneered the way in showcasing the most incredible, unique, and unusual dishes from all over the world.

feeds.title: Earth to Veg » European
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jellie. Each country boasts its own delectable specialties, while at the same time influencing and being influenced by the food culture of neighboring nations. Explore a variety of vegan European recipes from all over the continent. Earth to Veg is for the curious vegan home cook looking to explore diverse recipes from around the world.

feeds.title: Euro Rich Foodtrade Blog » Easy European Recipes
feeds.description: Euro Rich Food trade Corporation was born out of two sisters' love for travel and fine foods. Bring the best out of our authentic ingredients by cooking simple yet delicious dishes like risottos, truffle pasta, and other European dishes! Browse our easy-to-follow recipes and you're guaranteed to bring a restaurant-quality dish to the table.

feeds.title: Taste of Home » Europe
feeds.description: We've got all the European recipes you need, including Old World classics, eastern European favorites, and kid-friendly variations. Taste of Home was founded in 1993 on a simple premise: home cooks are the best cooks. It has been our privilege to share recipes and cooking inspiration with millions of people for almost three decades.

feeds.title: Cook Eat World » European Recipes
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Lee. Europe is small in size but the diversity of cuisines is huge. Travel from Scandinavia in the North through France, Spain, and Italy into Central Europe. Journey eastwards towards Asia through Greece, Croatia, Bulgaria, Turkey, and more. Cook Eat World brings you recipes from all these places. Hope you're enjoying all the delicious international cuisine!

feeds.title: Lemon Blossoms » European
feeds.description: Enjoy European recipes that are tasty and easy to make at home. You don't have to travel to enjoy the best of Italian cuisine, French cuisine, and much more. Hi and Welcome! I'm Kathy, a Professional Chef turned home cook and a total foodie at heart. I love to cook and teach. I read about food recipes, dream about food, talk about food, and write about food.

feeds.title: Food and Drink Business
feeds.description: Food and Drink Business News is the ultimate source for food and drink industry news and analysis. Dive into articles on Finance, Energy, Food Safety & Hygiene, and more. Food & Drink Business Europe is a long-established business magazine for the food and drinks processing industries. It is read by key decision makers and by buyers in the major retailers and food service operators.

feeds.title: Lizzy Loves Food » Europe
feeds.description: Traveling in Europe allowed my taste buds to explore new flavors for healthy recipes for the everyday cook. Simple crepes from France or for the most advanced cook try the Roasted Butternut Squash Ravioli with Creamy Sauce from Italy on a special occasion. Start your journey around Europe and stop by for some Greek Food or try some British recipes that will inspire your taste buds.

feeds.title: Pediaa » European Food
feeds.description: Pediaa is a place where you can discover European food and find inspiration for interesting recipes. Pediaa is a world of knowledge and information in every area; it has answers to all your queries, may it be what is, how to, which is, or where does. With Pediaa to assist, learning is made easy, nothing is hard to learn.

feeds.title: Food Perestroika
feeds.description: My name is Florian Pinel. Read recipes, restaurant reviews, and travel stories from all over the former Eastern Bloc: Central Europe, Russia, Caucasus, Central Asia, and more.

feeds.title: Mellow Masala » European
feeds.description: A fusion of global recipes - A food blog dedicated to European cuisines from around the different countries and connecting the cultures. My blog represents a fusion of global cultures and foods. My recipes try to capture the techniques, ingredients, and emotions associated. If you love exploring and experimenting with global cuisines, you will like my blog.

feeds.title: Chef's Pencil » Eastern European Cuisines
feeds.description: Chef's Pencil features content for all levels of cooks and foodies. Eastern European food is famous for its simple yet luscious foods. On this journey, discover traditional Russian, Georgian, and Ukrainian foods, hearty Polish dishes, traditional Romanian food, or amazing Armenian dishes. Eastern European desserts are also to die for and definitely worth a try.

feeds.title: Caroline's Cooking » Eastern European Recipes
feeds.description: Eastern Europe is home to a delicious range of cakes, cookies, and comfort foods. Some recipes are shared or have slight variations in a few countries, while others are more localized. All, though, are worth trying soon. I'm Caroline and this is where I share recipes inspired by travels, places I want to go, or just ideas from feeding the family.

feeds.title: Foodetc cooks » European Food
feeds.description: Discover news and tasty European Food recipes on Foodetc cooks. Foodetc cooks is a site about food, cooking, eating, travel, and recipes.

feeds.title: The Foodie's Avenue » European
feeds.description: European food recipes. A collection of European food recipes, French food, Spanish food, Mexican food, and more. Our goal is to create simple, easy-to-follow, and honestly good food recipes that everyone can re-create at home. We love a quick recipe hack as much as we love our traditional food, and a bit of experimenting in the kitchen - so expect all kinds of recipes on our page to suit your taste!

feeds.title: Jamie Geller » Eastern European
feeds.description: Find European Recipes, Appetizers, Desserts, Holiday Recipes & Healthy Cooking Tips here! Get cooking faster and easier with Jamie Geller as she serves up traditional Jewish, Kosher, and Israeli recipes with tips and hacks that make cooking for your family a breeze.

feeds.title: The Cook and The Writer » European Recipes
feeds.description: You'll find many European dishes you'll want to try soon here on The Cook and The Writer. We are Mike and Mary Johnston. We have been partners in life and mischief for a long, long time. We created this site to share our love of good food, good stories, interesting places, and memorable experiences.

feeds.title: Europe Dishes
feeds.description: Europe Dishes is a website where you can find different dishes from around Europe. you can also learn about different cuisine, find the best restaurant in the town and cities and in different countries! Within European Dishes, you can also find recipes, how-tos, curiosities as well as food product presentations.

feeds.title: ByTheMenu
feeds.description: ByTheMenu is a food blog that explores, shares, and celebrates the many unique foods and cultures across the globe. Embark on a culinary journey around the world! Discover the unique and delicious national dishes of different countries, learn about their cultures, and develop your taste buds along the way.

feeds.title: Only Gluten Free Recipes » Old Europe
feeds.description: Check out our gluten-free Eastern Europe for various Cuisines at Only Gluten Free Recipes. Kristina's selection of gluten-free recipes includes paleo, keto, vegetarian, vegan, grain-free, dairy-free, egg-free, kids favorites, and for those who follow a calorie-restricted diet, cooking light recipes.

feeds.title: Euro Food Seattle Blog
feeds.description: European Cuisines Blog is your source to read about popular as well as rare but delicious European dinners, German cuisine, Hungarian cuisine, and other famous dishes.

feeds.title: GypsyPlate » European Recipes
feeds.description: Our collection of European dishes spans the continent, from Dublin Coddle and Jagerschnitzel from the Northern climates to Olive Tapenade and Spanish Garlic Shrimp from the southern side. Hi, we're Jason and Alpana Beiser. We love exploring cuisines from around the world and are so glad you have decided to join me on this culinary journey!
